body_markdown:
Event planners can use[business storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/business-storage) to organize reusable décor, equipment, linens, signage, and seasonal inventory between events. A dedicated storage unit can keep supplies out of a home, office, or garage while making upcoming event setups easier to prepare.


From weddings and corporate gatherings to birthday parties and community events, reusable supplies can add up quickly. Backdrops, display pieces, lighting equipment, tables, and packing materials all need a place between events.


## Event Planner Storage Essentials:


- Store reusable décor, linens, signage, display pieces, and event equipment by category.
- Keep supplies for the next event near the unit entrance.
- Label bins on at least two sides by event type, season, or contents.
- Keep an inventory list before buying, renting, or replacing event supplies.
- Store bulky backdrops, furniture, and lower-use inventory along the back and side walls.
- Leave a clear walkway through the unit for access.
- Use storage for supplies and inventory, not as a business address or place to operate a business.


## Why Do Event Planners Use Self Storage?


Event planners use self storage to keep reusable supplies and equipment in one organized place. For independent planners and growing event businesses, inventory can quickly outgrow a spare room, garage, or office.


A storage unit can provide room for supplies used only a few times each month without requiring a larger permanent workspace.


**Event planners may use storage for:**


- Backdrops and display stands
- Linens and table coverings
- Signs and reusable printed materials
- Artificial floral arrangements and décor
- Lighting and audiovisual equipment
- Tables, chairs, and event furniture
- Empty bins, boxes, and packing materials
- Seasonal decorations and event supplies


Review facility rules before packing event materials. Do not store food, beverages, fuel, hazardous materials, flammable items, or other prohibited supplies.


## How Can Storage Help With Seasonal Event Inventory?


Storage can help event planners separate seasonal inventory from the supplies needed now. Holiday décor, graduation displays, summer-event supplies, and other seasonal pieces do not need to take up workspace year-round.


Packing seasonal items away by event type can free up room and make current inventory easier to manage.


**To simplify seasonal rotation:**


- Label bins clearly on more than one side.
- Group supplies by season or event type.
- Keep the next season’s inventory where it is easy to reach.
- Store off-season items farther back in the unit.
- Update your inventory after each event season.


This can help prevent digging through holiday décor while preparing for a June wedding or searching through graduation signage before a fall corporate event.


## How Should Event Planners Organize a Storage Unit?


Event planners should organize a storage unit by category, frequency of use, and upcoming event needs. Shelving can use vertical space while keeping smaller supplies visible.


Assign each shelf, wall, or storage zone a category, such as linens, signage, lighting, backdrops, artificial florals, or seasonal décor.


**For easier access:**


- Keep supplies for upcoming events near the entrance.
- Store bulky or infrequently used items farther back.
- Label bins by contents, event type, or season.
- Leave a clear walkway through the unit.
- Keep a simple inventory of what you have and where it is located.
- Take photos of completed storage zones for quick reference.


An inventory list can help you check supplies before purchasing or renting more.


## What Size Storage Unit Is Best for an Event Planning Business?


The best storage unit size for an event planning business depends on the type and quantity of inventory you need to store. Measure large items, such as backdrops, furniture, shelving, and display stands, before selecting a unit.

Use the[Public Storage size guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) to compare unit sizes before reserving.


## Is Drive-Up Storage Useful for Event Planners?


[Drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) can be useful for event planners who regularly load and unload bulky supplies. It lets you park a vehicle near a ground-level unit for moving bins, display pieces, furniture, equipment, and other event materials between storage and an event site.


More than 45% of Public Storage properties offer drive-up access units, totaling more than 2,200 locations. Confirm unit availability, access details, and dimensions at your selected location before reserving.


For planners managing early setups, late breakdowns, or weekend events,[24/7](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/24-hour-storage) access is available at select Public Storage locations. Confirm access hours before relying on this option for an event schedule.


## Should Event Planners Consider Climate-Controlled Storage?


[Climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) provides a more consistent indoor environment for event supplies affected by significant temperature or humidity changes.


**Climate control may be useful for:**


- Artificial florals and certain décor
- Linens and fabric items
- Paper products and printed materials
- Lighting, audiovisual equipment, and electronics
- Wood display pieces and furniture


More than 90% of Public Storage properties offer climate-controlled units. Confirm current unit types, features, and availability at your selected location before reserving.


## Can Self Storage Help a Growing Event Business?


Self storage can give an event planning business more room as it adds clients, events, and reusable inventory. Instead of filling an office, garage, or home with supplies, planners can create a separate storage space for décor, equipment, and seasonal materials.


Month-to-month rentals can provide flexibility as inventory changes throughout the year. Public Storage offers online reservations and move-in options that can help planners compare available unit sizes and features before adding storage.


## Keep Event Supplies Organized and Ready for What’s Next.


A well-organized storage unit can help event planners keep reusable inventory accessible, reduce overflow in offices and garages, and simplify transitions between events. Choose a unit size that fits your current inventory, organize supplies around your event calendar, and update your inventory after each setup and breakdown.


Less searching. More celebrating.


## Event Planner Storage FAQs


**What Can Event Planners Store Between Events?**
Event planners can store reusable décor, linens, signage, backdrops, artificial florals, tables, chairs, lighting equipment, audiovisual equipment, shelving, packing materials, and seasonal supplies. Do not store food, beverages, fuel, hazardous materials, flammable items, or other prohibited supplies.


**What Size Storage Unit Does an Event Planner Need?**
A 5×5 unit can fit linens, compact décor bins, signage, and small supplies. A 10×10 or larger unit can fit backdrops, shelving, tables, furniture, and inventory for multiple event setups.


**How Do Event Planners Organize a Storage Unit?**
Group supplies by category, event type, season, and frequency of use. Keep upcoming-event supplies near the entrance, store bulky backdrops and furniture along the walls, and maintain a clear aisle through the unit.


**Is Drive-Up Storage Useful for Event Supplies?**
[Drive-up storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage/drive-up-storage) can help event planners load and unload furniture, backdrops, décor bins, tables, equipment, and other bulky supplies from a vehicle. More than 45% of Public Storage properties offer drive-up access units.


**Is Climate-Controlled Storage Useful for Event Inventory?**
[Climate-controlled storage](https://www.publicstorage.com/climate-controlled-storage) can be useful for linens, artificial florals, paper goods, printed materials, lighting equipment, audiovisual equipment, wood display pieces, and furniture. More than 90% of Public Storage properties offer climate-controlled units.


**Can Event Planners Use a Storage Unit as a Business Address?**
No. Do not use a storage unit as a business address or place to operate an event planning business. Use the unit to store approved inventory, equipment, décor, and supplies.
